_comment: BAND-SPLIT-2. This band's own dialogue container -- see band1_lower_meadows.json in this same directory for the full reasoning. Same `{"conversations": {...}}` shape as opening.json/village.json/trainers.json/relay.json/stronghold.json/meadows_freed.json, merged onto the same table by scripts/story/dialogue_runner.gd::table() (EXTRA_DIALOGUE_PATHS). Filed 2026-08-17 specifically because this band had a ranger camp shipping and no dialogue file to put its trainer's lines in -- see ralph/NOTES.md.

quarry_dorn_challenge.speaker: Dorn
lines: Seams are company ground. Have been since before your village had an opinion about it.
You want stone out of them, you're a problem I'm paid to have. Let's get it over with.

quarry_dorn_defeated.speaker: Dorn
lines: Take your stone. It's not the stone anyone up the line actually cares about.
And don't thank me. I'd have stopped you if I could have.

warrens_pell_challenge.speaker: Pell
lines: That hole behind me is ours. We cut it, we hold it, and nobody local goes down it.
Dorn let you past. Dorn's soft. I'd back my three against your whole string.

warrens_pell_defeated.speaker: Pell
lines: Fine. Go down. You'll last about as long as the last one who did.
Something's been living in there since long before we started digging, and it doesn't care whose badge you're not wearing.

band2_kest_challenge.speaker: Kest
lines: You cleared the warrens and kept walking. Most don't.
Doesn't matter to me why. You're still on the wrong side of this road.

band2_kest_defeated.speaker: Kest
lines: Go on, then. Not like I'm the last one you'll run into between here and the river.
Tell whoever's paying you attention that the seams don't end at the warrens door.

_comment_trainers: TRAINER-JOURNEY, then BAND2-63. The band's third Team Tether picket (data/config/bands/band2_stone_and_root/trainers.json order 2002) added a third pair of lines to the same shape the first two already use. Doctrine, not lore dump (prompt 59): two lines each, talking about the job, no legendary name (tests/test_dialogue_runner.gd::test_no_dialogue_before_the_stronghold_names_the_legendary enforces that everywhere). Kest's own lines are the one place in this file that looks FORWARD rather than at the door behind him -- 'between here and the river' is the region handing the player off to Band 3 the same way Dorn handed off to Pell.
